source.content:
The following player macros are added when importing the Bane of Azeroth Adventure. They can be dragged to the hotbar for quick access.

Change Druid Form

Opens the same form-switching dialog as Change Form on the Druid character sheet.

End Effects

Opens the Bane of Azeroth effect-ending dialog for the character.

For a player, the macros use an owned selected token when possible, otherwise the assigned character or another owned character. A GM must select exactly one token before using these macros.
